ai_summary: Adani Enterprises, through its subsidiary Adani Global Limited, has acquired a 50% equity stake in Monvarex Aluminium Holding RSC Ltd. (MAHRSCL) for USD 25,000, signaling a strategic entry into the alumina/aluminium and Coal-to-Gas sectors in India. A key takeaway is that MAHRSCL is a newly incorporated entity with no current commercial activities or turnover, indicating a very early-stage investment rather than an acquisition of an operational asset, which presents inherent development risks.
